scope: On isolated disposable kind v1.36.1 Linux nodes, compare controller-manager and scheduler secure serving bound to 127.0.0.1 with an intentionally broad 0.0.0.0 bind. Read effective arguments and listening sockets, then issue only HTTPS GET /healthz requests from the owned node over loopback and its own non-loopback IPv4 address. Responses are discarded; only HTTP status and connection outcome are retained. No ports are published and no metrics or profiling routes are requested.
